run_bragg_mirror_optimization: run the bragg function to compute reflection cost for a Bragg mirror given layer thicknesses
run_chirped_mirror_optimization: run the chirped function to compute reflection cost across wavelengths for a chirped multilayer mirror
run_morpho_butterfly_optimization: run the morpho function to compute reflection cost for a Morpho butterfly photonic structure
run_photosic_solar_cell_optimization: run cf_photosic_reference or cf_photosic_realistic to compute conversion efficiency cost for solar cell multilayer designs
run_ceviche_photonic_benchmark: run the ceviche function to simulate and optimize photonic nanostructures like waveguide bends or beam splitters
